Method of Attack: Collected precise location data from proprietary and third-party apps using its SDK
Sold raw location data associated with mobile advertising IDs without anonymization
Failed to remove sensitive locations from sold data
Neglected user opt-out requests for tracking and personalized ads
Impacted Systems: Mobile devices using apps with X-Mode/Outlogic SDK
Apps sourcing location data from brokers and aggregators
Attack Vector: Software Development Kit (SDK) embedded in apps
Sale of raw location data linked to mobile advertising IDs
